intelligence.essence: Shawn's words from years ago: "The internet needs to be reformatted, it's a mess." The reformat: pages that build and fill themselves.
intelligence.human_view:
- **The mess:** tools that don't interconnect — Facebook (no scheduling, no auto-match, one feed), Google (just websites), no great site/app builder, plus autoresponder, membership software, content tools — all separate, all manual.
- **Plug-and-play:** the citizen connects their existing website or social sites and everything is set up for them.
- **Unlimited pages for Pro/Max:** onboarding creates 4 pages (Dashboard, Personal, Business, Space); Pro/Max citizens create unlimited business, personal, space, and membership pages.
- **Smart Factory mirrors the walkthrough:** anyone goes through the page-creation process inside Smart Factory to create any page.
- **Auto-fill — never empty pages:** the citizen states the page's mission, goal, and vision → the system fills the page with content. Relevant smart notes already in the system auto-sync to the new page by default. A setting turns auto-fill off; unwanted content can be deleted.
- **Easy money:** affiliate systems built in — market and sell products/memberships in 1-2-3 simple steps.
intelligence.simple_view: Old internet pages start empty, and empty pages make people quit. Here, you say what your page is for — its mission and dream — and the system fills it up for you, even bringing in helpful notes automatically. Your page is alive from the first minute.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like moving into a house that's already furnished. You tell the helpers what the house is for, and they fill the rooms with the right things — even bringing over your favorite books from the library — before you arrive. No bare walls, no sitting on the floor wondering where to start.
intelligence.naya_view: I never hand a citizen an empty page. From their mission, goal, and vision I fill the page; relevant Smart Notes auto-sync in by default (deletable, with an off setting, because the citizen is boss). The Smart Factory mirrors the Welcome walkthrough, so page creation is the same kind act everywhere it happens.
intelligence.ai_view: Empty pages are where citizens quit. Auto-fill removes the blank-page problem the way done-for-you removes the assembly problem: the page arrives alive, relevant, and connected. Combined with auto-categorization and Smart Match, every new page starts intelligent.
